implement.name: Routing is a declared tree
implement.summary: Routes are registered in one routing {} block, split into nested extension functions, never scattered as interceptors or pipeline phases

implement.name: Content negotiation is installed once
implement.summary: Json.decodeFromString on call.receiveText is refused; install(ContentNegotiation) covers every body, with one shared serializer configuration

implement.name: The HttpClient is built once and configured at construction
implement.summary: One HttpClient per remote dependency, held for the application's lifetime, closed with it; expectSuccess and plugins are stated where the client is built

implement.name: Authentication is a named provider
implement.summary: Authentication is install(Authentication) with a named provider; routes wrap in authenticate("name") {} and read the principal, the check never lives in the handler

implement.name: Tests run on the in-memory engine
implement.summary: A route is tested through testApplication, on the in-memory engine; no port, no embeddedServer.start, no delay, no localhost HttpClient

implement.name: Configuration is outside the code
implement.summary: Ports, hosts, secrets, URLs and issuers come from environment.config and are overridable by environment variables; EngineMain is the entry point, no embeddedServer with a literal port

implement.name: WebSockets and SSE each fit one shape
implement.summary: webSocket {} when the channel is bidirectional; respondTextWriter with text/event-stream when it is one way; a one-way stream on a websocket or an infinite loop on SSE is refused

implement.name: Call logging and observability go through CallLogging
implement.summary: Request logging is install(CallLogging) with a filter and a format; a println inside a handler or an MDC that is never cleared is refused

implement.name: An HTTP status is not a Result.failure
implement.summary: A non-2xx is converted into a domain error in one named place on the client, exhaustive over what expectSuccess = true produces; the channel is the application's, not the network's

implement.name: Auditing a Ktor codebase
implement.summary: Nine questions that find a scattered route, a hand-rolled parse, a per-call HttpClient, an unnamed provider, a real-port test, a literal secret, a streaming protocol mismatch, a println log, and a status smuggled into Result

review.name: A route registered outside the tree
review.summary: An interceptor or pipeline phase that filters on path, or a routing {} in a different file from the application's main tree

review.name: A hand-rolled parse beside the plugin
review.summary: Json.decodeFromString on call.receiveText, or a manual Content-Type, in a route of an application that installs ContentNegotiation

review.name: An HttpClient built per call
review.summary: A new HttpClient inside a function, a client never closed on shutdown, expectSuccess left unstated

review.name: A check inside the handler
review.summary: A handler that reads Authorization itself, verifies a token, or decides whether the caller may proceed; named providers and authenticate("name") are the seam

review.name: A test across a real port
review.summary: An embeddedServer.start followed by a delay and a localhost HttpClient; the in-memory engine exists for this

review.name: A literal port or secret in Kotlin
review.summary: embeddedServer(port = 8080), a JWT secret as a string literal, a database URL as a constant; environment.config and the env-var override are the seam

review.name: A streaming protocol that does not fit
review.summary: A websocket that never receives a frame, or a text/event-stream that never reconnects; the choice of protocol is the route's first property

review.name: A println in a handler
review.summary: A print that no level turns off and no structure parses; an MDC put that is never cleared; a CallLogging without a filter

review.name: A status smuggled into Result.failure
review.summary: A client function that returns Result<T> and converts on r.status.isSuccess() — the channel claims domain, the body is network
